Mainly for land beneath leased buildings subject to the former Land Lease Act and former House Lease Act, the company purchases properties from landowners, raises their real estate value through rights adjustment, and then sells them. The company and two consolidated subsidiaries (Sansei Landic Funding Co., Ltd., which undertakes fund formation work for the company's business, and Hachimantai Kanko Kassei Godo Kaisha, which was established to operate accommodation facilities) conduct this business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥23,348 million.
entries.6cd1083b99283f1b: Since 1991, it has handled leased land, which general real estate companies have not often treated as a transaction target, and for leased land to which the old law applies, it has methods for advancing rights adjustment, such as confirming boundaries with adjacent land, subdividing by leased-land parcel, and negotiating with leasehold rights holders. For vacant houses, it conducts vacation negotiations, including requesting tenants to vacate, introducing relocation destinations, and bearing relocation costs. Until sale, in addition to obtaining ground rent, through "Owners Partner," which acts on behalf of landowners for collection of ground rent, contract renewal procedures and other work, it also undertakes management work for landowners.
